latest.subject: Thank you! You just helped improve someone's life!

fields.text:
Congratulations!! 
 
We just received an order for C518212 Tom Stevens from Tri State Mobility.  

This is another customer that will enjoy the benefits of having a  Lift. 

You played a big part in helping improve their quality of life!

Thank you!
 
ISR - Jacob Zeiner
CSR - - Dexter Vorbe
DSM - Jan Sperre
